sentences.text: As the clock struck 04:00, the ironed room began a strange, ethereal performance as the air started drying out.
The spectral humidity plummeted, dropping to 32.8 % in the ironing room, which was far below the expected 37.5 %.
At 05:30, the peak of this strange dehumidifying activity was reached, suggesting a mischievous, unseen guest.
The haunting sensation persisted until 06:00, leaving the house's humidity well below the predicted range of 37.0 % to 38.1 %.
